strategy_roster.name: FiboChannel Line
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,6) > ema(close,85) and roc(close,14) > 0.3 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,6) < ema(close,85) or roc(close,14) < 0 or macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(6)/EMA(85) proxy the documented LWMA stack, ROC(14)>0.3 approximates the momentum threshold, and MACD(12,26,9) is retained. The documented 1% stop and 2% target are kept; channel slope, higher timeframe, and equity controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Dual Stoploss
strategy_roster.notes: This is a stop-management utility that explicitly opens no positions and requires broker stop levels and existing orders. An impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating a long entry.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Following KNN
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(20)>0 is the permitted proxy for positive average price change, and the documented SMA(50) filter is retained. The inverse change/MA condition exits; the short side and machine-learning label are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: DeMark Lines
strategy_roster.notes: A prior two-bar high break above SMA(21) is a rolling trendline-breakout proxy; the prior low break exits. Validated DeMark pivots, trendline slopes, pip buffers, and alerts are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Smoothed Heiken-Ashi
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close > ema(close,40) and roc(close,1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish candle above EMA(40) with positive one-bar ROC proxies a smoothed bullish Heiken-Ashi body expanding. The custom HA candle and previous-body comparison are unavailable, while the bearish body serves as exit.

strategy_roster.name: IU Break of Any Session
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break is a rolling session-range breakout proxy, with the opposite low break as exit. Session clocks, entry-bar stop, risk/reward, and scheduled closing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Inside Candle
strategy_roster.notes: Breaking above the prior candle high while holding above its low is the bullish breakout proxy for an inside-candle mother range. The mother-candle state, configurable risk/reward, and opposite breakout are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Polarized Fractal Efficiency
strategy_roster.notes: PFE is unavailable, so a positive two-bar ROC cross with one-bar acceleration proxies the documented three-bar efficiency reversal. The short branch, configurable PFE period, and point-based protection are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Pendulum Swing
strategy_roster.notes: A rolling range breakout is a stateless proxy for the pending buy/sell-stop swing; the opposite range break exits. Dynamic daily range, martingale levels, equity targets, and pip management are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Vwap Macd
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) is the explicit value-line proxy for VWAP, with documented MACD(12,26,9) alignment; the opposite MACD or value cross exits. The documented 2% stop is retained, while VWAP and ATR-based risk are unavailable.
